next.reason: 1985: "The first LINE NUMBER clause specified within a PAGE FOOTING report group must be an absolute LINE NUMBER clause."; 2023: "If the report group is a page footing, the line number is given by (FOOTING integer + integer-2).". 2023 GR-13.18.35.4-5 b)4 defines a relative first LINE clause in a page footing. No SR keeps the absolute-only restriction, so the 1985 requirement is dropped.
